sourceEvidence: v0.14 exact-stack actuation used create:creative_motor + create:cogwheel to drive the Swivel hidden extra cog without directly writing targetAngleDegrees.
Create CreativeMotorBlockEntity exposes generatedSpeed through ScrollValueBehaviour.setValue(int), so source sign can be reversed through the real kinetic generator.
The accepted v0.14 outbound source was active for networkSettleTicks + commandTicks; v0.16 applies the exact inverse source sign for the same active-tick duration.
Sable Swivel target integration is driven by measured hidden-cog RPM while physical child orientation remains constrained by the real rotary servo.
